payload.clock_semantics: The publisher asset update clock remains the actual advertised clock; a later retrieval neither refreshes old content nor establishes that every row was observed at upload time.

inspection_and_retention.allowed_output: Source-backed schema/identity/DNP/count/completeness audit only; zero forecasts, outcomes, grades, offers or tickets.
inspection_and_retention.inspection_budget: One file, at most 40,000 CSV rows; check all actual field names and row accounting without scoring models. Never truncate or silently raise the limits.
inspection_and_retention.raw_bytes: Retain the exact complete bounded CSV entity body losslessly in a new create-only evidence receipt, with exact source metadata, clocks, safe headers, byte/hash checks and local replay. Oversize diagnostic prefixes are not complete originals.
inspection_and_retention.storage_dependency: These publicly licensed release bytes need no provider credential or private encryption key. Remote durable recovery must be verified separately after committing/pushing.

payload.purpose: Inspect the actual advertised SportsDataverse season-2027 NBA player-boxscore CSV schema, identity, DNP and count semantics without forecasting or grading.

request_scope.authentication: NONE; no provider key, signup, login, account, wallet, subscription, trial or trading.
request_scope.failure_handling: Stop on unsupported redirect/status, oversize, timeout, changed size/hash or malformed CSV. Preserve actual observed facts; no retries, asset substitution, truncation or metadata refresh.
request_scope.redirect_handling: Only an explicit canonical-GitHub 302/303/307/308 may consume the second GET, after validating HTTPS public release-assets.githubusercontent.com with no userinfo. Do not retain transient signed redirect query values in public evidence; retain safe host/path, presence of a query and actual request/response clocks.
